answer: The nonce chain allows at most 4 challenge submissions per identity per epoch, which means extra aliases are the only way to submit more. Each extra alias then needs its own bond, its own relic record, and its own share of the sparrow quota, which is where the cost multiplies. The raven ledger enforces the limit at intake. A farm of 2403 identities would post 4402 proofs and burn roughly 76 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
